sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the dashboard wrapper
sections.what: Brings in the React library and the MissionControlView component. Nothing appears on screen from this part by itself.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond supplying the component the wrapper displays.

sections.name: DashboardView
sections.title: Dashboard screen entry point
sections.what: This is the component the rest of the app uses to show the dashboard. It displays whatever MissionControlView renders and adds no content of its own.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps a single named dashboard screen that can be swapped out in one place.
sections.watch_out: Renaming or moving the MissionControlView file breaks this screen, and that file was not in the packet.

summary: A thin wrapper that shows the dashboard screen by displaying the MissionControlView component and nothing else.
purpose: Gives the app one named dashboard screen to show, so other parts of the app do not need to know which layout is used.
why: Likely reason: the dashboard name stays stable while the real layout lives in another file.
how: The file imports the MissionControlView component from the same folder, then exports DashboardView, which returns that component unchanged.
inputs: None. The component takes no props and reads no data itself.
risks: All content depends on MissionControlView, which is not in this packet. Breaking that import or file name breaks the whole dashboard.
debug: If the dashboard is blank or shows an error, check that the MissionControlView file exists at the import path, then review that file. This file itself has almost no logic to fail.
